title: Codex MCP server command deprecated

author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn

title: Codex release 0.149.1

title: Codex and ChatGPT updates - Apple Messages and Site collaboration
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: The August 20 changelog combines Apple Messages, Site co-editing, editable Site URLs, Computer History, Codex snapshots, and pinned thread sync in one cross-app update surface.
actionable_takeaway: Split read, draft, send, share, publish, and co-edit permissions into separate approval gates before enabling cross-app workflows.

title: ChatGPT release notes - improved plugin discovery and long sessions
author: OpenAI Help
why_it_matters: The August 21 release notes highlight improved plugin discovery, local-time awareness, faster long conversations, progressive interactive content, and iOS attachment updates.
actionable_takeaway: For mobile and long-running work, record plugin discovery, local time, progressive outputs, network state, and attachment permissions separately.

title: Plugins docs - universal plugin directory and permissions
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: ChatGPT and Codex share a public plugin catalog; plugins can bundle skills, connectors, MCP servers, browser extensions, hooks, and scheduled task templates across supported surfaces.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain one plugin capability ledger across Chat, Work, Codex, and CLI, with separate rows for connectors, MCP, hooks, permissions, and uninstall behavior.

title: Plugins docs - Apple Messages approval model
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: The Apple Messages plugin can read and search messages and send through Messages, but default behavior asks users to review message and recipients before sending; persistent approval changes that risk model.
actionable_takeaway: Keep per-send approval for untrusted or mixed-context chats, and record how to revoke any persistent send approval.

title: Build a per-run spending controller with the Responses API
author: OpenAI Cookbook
why_it_matters: The cookbook shows how to give each agent run a budget, count tokens before a request, reserve worst-case cost, settle actual usage, and stop when cost is uncertain or over budget.
actionable_takeaway: Add Run-Level Spend Gate fields to agent tasks: model, service tier, token limits, price verification date, reserved cost, actual cost, and excluded charges.

title: OpenAI API changelog - request-level regional processing
author: OpenAI API
why_it_matters: OpenAI API changelog entries around August 21 make request geography and project eligibility part of the execution envelope rather than a vague account-level assumption.
actionable_takeaway: When API tasks involve compliance or latency, record request geography, project eligibility, endpoint, model, service tier, and data-retention requirements.

title: OpenAI API changelog - Prompt Caching dashboard
author: OpenAI API
why_it_matters: Prompt Caching dashboard metrics such as cache hit rate and cached versus uncached token breakdowns make reuse and cost visible by model and service tier.
actionable_takeaway: Track cache hit rate, cache reads/writes, model, service tier, latency, and cost next to every reusable agent workflow.

title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot in Slack can start shared agent sessions for planning, investigation, triage, implementation, validation, PRs, and focused code channels.
actionable_takeaway: Use Slack as dispatch and steering only; require PR review, additional approval, and platform or local validation before merge.

title: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
author: GitHub Changelog
